item_title: Fourteen sites, four teams, one very long equipment list
item_introduction: The summer campaign opened this week across the alpine and coastal networks — with the first deployments of the rebuilt nitrate kits.

add_image.image_alt: The alpine field station below a snow-covered mountain
add_image.image_caption: Storglommen station at the start of the 2026 summer campaign.

add_paragraph: The alpine crew reached **Storglommen** on Monday to find the access track still partly snow-covered and the station's south-facing sensor mast bent by the winter. They spent the first day digging out the snowpack array and the second rebuilding the mast.

On the coast, the monthly sediment-trap round began at **Station Nord-03** and the two southern estuary sites. The new biofouling-compensation firmware went into all six turbidity sensors without a failure, which is better than last year's three-out-of-six.

This season also sees the first field deployment of the low-cost nitrate kits built over winter. Twelve units go out across the network, with a calibration check against the laboratory method at each site. Daily field notes stay on the internal dashboard; public updates follow as each site comes online.
